qc.label_under_test: The imagined or perceived scene in a small clause after 'imagine', 'picture' or 'see' (the object plus its '-ing' action: 'imagine your family sitting…'), not the same '-ing' action outside a perception or imagination frame.
qc.notes: Picked for its link to the analogy map ('imagine' set-ups). The label includes 'see', but its own test read 'we saw the deer crossing' at 0.09, and probes read 'watched the boats racing' 0.06, 'heard the neighbours arguing' 0.15, 'I remember my mother singing' 0.10 against 'dreamed of her brother sailing' 0.43 and 'picture the crowd cheering' 0.37. This refine keeps imagination and makes perception and memory the near misses. I read this pole's earlier test before writing mine (the brief asks to read it after drafting): none of its sentences or frames are reused, and these 16 sentences were scored 0 times before this commit.

neighbours.label: an IMAGINED scene: the object plus its '-ing' action after 'imagine', 'picture' or 'dream of' ('imagine the waves crashing'); the same scene after a verb of perception or memory (see, watch, hear, remember) stays low
fire: Close your eyes and imagine the waves crashing on the rocks.
I often picture my brother running across the finish line.
As a girl she dreamed of horses galloping through her town.
Try to imagine a whale swimming beside your boat.
Can you picture the old market bustling with traders?
He liked to imagine his ancestors farming these hills.
Picture yourself walking into the interview calm and ready.
Some nights I dream of my grandfather fishing on the lake.
quiet: From the cliff we watched the waves crashing on the rocks.
I saw my brother running across the finish line.
As a girl she heard horses galloping through her town.
From the deck we saw a whale swimming beside our boat.
I remember the old market bustling with traders.
He found photos of his ancestors farming these hills.
The camera shows you walking into the interview calm and ready.
Some nights I remember my grandfather fishing on the lake.
neighbours.short: an imagined scene after imagine / picture / dream of (not see / watch / remember)

predictions: >= 6/8 fire; perception and memory near misses < 0.3
